_README: Template for one ThAI Novel episode. Drop a copy of this file into ./in/
(e.g. ./in/02_devil-cafe-ep02.json), fill in the PER_EPISODE fields, then
FIXED        Set once per CHANNEL. Don't change between episodes.
Voice, image style, intro logo, music palette, ffmpeg settings.
PER_SERIES   Set once per SERIES. Shared by all episodes in the same series.
PER_EPISODE  Changes EVERY episode. This is where the story lives.
Episode id, title, chapters, narration_blocks, end_card.
OPTIONAL     Has a sensible default — omit if you don't need it.
All fields starting with _ (like _README, _doc, _note) are pure comments.
Pydantic ignores them silently. You can add your own anywhere.
JSON has no native comments, so we use _doc objects/arrays.
If your editor warns about 'unknown property', that's expected — it's a comment.

_doc.id: PER_EPISODE | REQUIRED | slug-safe (a-z, 0-9, -, _). Becomes the output filename: novels/<id>/output/final.mp4
_doc.title: PER_EPISODE | REQUIRED | shown on the title card + spoken in the intro narration
_doc.series: PER_SERIES  | OPTIONAL | groups episodes for batch-publishing tooling later
_doc.episode: PER_EPISODE | OPTIONAL | integer; used to build 'ตอนที่ N' if intro.title_narration is not set
_doc.theme: PER_SERIES  | OPTIONAL | for your own reference; not used by the pipeline
_doc.resolution: FIXED       | '1280x720' is the sweet spot (~14 MB / 9 min). '1920x1080' is 3x bigger and ~30s slower
_doc.target_duration_min: PER_EPISODE | OPTIONAL | advisory only — actual duration comes from real audio length

project.title: <ชื่อตอน>
project.series: ร้านกาแฟของคุณปีศาจ

_doc._intent: FIXED — the channel's voice and pacing. Don't override unless you know why.
_doc.engine: FIXED | 'edge-tts' (Microsoft, free, networked). Alternative: 'piper' (local, slower setup)
_doc.voice: FIXED | 'th-TH-PremwadeeNeural' is the cozy female voice. Other Thai voices: th-TH-NiwatNeural (male)
_doc.rate: FIXED | speech rate. '-10%' = 10% slower than baseline. Cozy/romantic stories want -10% to -15%
_doc.pitch: FIXED | '+0Hz' = unchanged. Use '+1Hz' / '-1Hz' to nudge brightness; bigger values sound robotic
_doc.sentence_pause_ms: FIXED | gap between sentences in milliseconds. 300 = brisk, 400 = cozy, 500 = melancholy
_doc.paragraph_pause_ms: FIXED | longer gap after paragraphs (rarely tweaked)
_doc.mood_pauses: FIXED | per-mood overrides. Pipeline picks the override that matches each narration_block's mood.

_doc._intent: FIXED — the channel's image-gen settings. The visual style across episodes should look consistent.
_doc.engine: FIXED | 'sdxl-turbo' is the only one wired right now
_doc.backend: FIXED | 'mlx' is reserved; current implementation uses diffusers+MPS
_doc.steps: FIXED | SDXL Turbo is designed for 1–4 steps. 4 = best quality. Higher does NOT help (it's distilled)
_doc.guidance: FIXED | SDXL Turbo forces guidance to 0.0 internally — value here is ignored for sdxl-turbo
_doc.seed: FIXED | pin a number for reproducibility. Same seed + same prompt = same image
_doc.gen_width: FIXED | 1024 is SDXL Turbo's sweet spot
_doc.gen_height: FIXED | 576 = 16:9 to match the output. Don't change without reason

_doc._intent: FIXED — the channel's aesthetic. Prepended to every visual_anchor.prompt.
_doc.base_prompt: FIXED | always applied. The 'house style' of the channel.
_doc.negative_prompt: FIXED | what to avoid — keep generic across episodes
_doc.color_grade: FIXED | global default. Per-anchor color_grade overrides this. Values: warm_cozy | cool_night | golden_hour | melancholy_blue | playful_pop | neutral

visual_style.base_prompt: cinematic romantic anime style, cozy nostalgic atmosphere, warm amber lighting, soft focus, painterly, shallow depth of field, film grain, 35mm
visual_style.negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, bad anatomy, deformed hands, text, watermark, logo, oversaturated, harsh shadows, cluttered

_characters_doc: PER_SERIES — set once for the whole series. Same characters across all episodes in a series.
Keys (male_lead / female_lead) are free-form labels — call them whatever you want.
The 'appearance' string is what SDXL needs to draw the character consistently.
Be SPECIFIC: hair color/style, eye color, age range, distinctive features.
Be CONSISTENT: copy the SAME appearance string between episodes to keep visuals matching.
Doc lives here (sibling of 'characters') instead of inside it because 'characters'
is a dict-of-models — extra keys at that level would fail validation.

male_lead.name: <ชื่อตัวเอกชาย>
male_lead.appearance: young Thai man in his mid-20s, [specific hair/eyes/expression/distinctive feature]
male_lead.wardrobe: [default outfit — copy across episodes for consistency]
male_lead.voice_notes: narrator only — dialogue is described, not voiced

female_lead.name: <ชื่อตัวเอกหญิง>
female_lead.appearance: beautiful Thai woman in her mid-20s, [specific hair/eyes/expression/distinctive feature]
female_lead.wardrobe: [default outfit — copy across episodes for consistency]
female_lead.voice_notes: narrator only — dialogue is described, not voiced

_doc._intent: FIXED — the channel's audio palette. Track refs use library:// scheme; drop the actual mp3s in library/audio/{music,ambience}/
_doc.music_bed: FIXED | per-mood music selection. Pipeline picks based on the block's mood.
_doc._volume_units: volume_db is negative (quieter than 0). -22 dB = comfortable bed under narration
_doc._duck_explainer: duck_during_dialogue_db: how much to drop music while narration plays. -6 to -8 dB is standard

_doc._intent: FIXED | default off. Subtitles overlay on the image and can crowd cinematic frames.
_doc._export: Even when enabled=false, an .srt file is still written next to final.mp4 (upload as YouTube captions)
_doc.enabled: FIXED | false = clean image, no on-screen text

_doc._intent: FIXED for channel branding (logo, music, durations). PER_EPISODE only changes via project.title → spoken automatically.
_doc.show: FIXED | true = show 5s logo + 4.5s title card before the story starts
_doc.channel_name: FIXED | spoken in the welcome narration: 'ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ช่อง <channel_name>'
_doc.welcome_duration_sec: FIXED | how long the logo stays on screen (also caps the welcome narration)
_doc.title_card_duration_sec: FIXED | how long the episode title card stays on screen
_doc.background_music_ref: FIXED | music under the intro. library://music/<name>
_doc.logo_ref: FIXED | full-screen logo image. library://overlays/<name>. Falls back to intro/logo.png convention

_doc: PER_EPISODE — this is where the story lives.
Aim for 4–6 chapters per 30-minute episode. Each chapter = one visual anchor + 1–3 narration blocks.
Chapter id must be slug-safe: 'ch_01', 'ch_02', ...
show_title_card: default FALSE — this is an audiobook, so silent title cards between chapters are dead air. Set true only for deliberate visual interludes.
chapters.title: <หัวข้อตอน — ภาษาไทย>

_doc: Pick ONE: 'prompt' (generate new) OR 'ref' (reuse from library). Never both.
Option A — generate + promote (first time you use this scene):
prompt: English description for SDXL
save_to_library_as: slug-safe name. Image gets saved to library/visuals/backgrounds/<name>.png
Next episode can then use ref: 'library://backgrounds/<name>'
Option B — reuse an existing library image (preferred — keeps style consistent):
ref: 'library://backgrounds/<name>'  (no prompt)
motion: kept for future use. Currently the composer ignores it — all chapter images are static.
color_grade: per-anchor override of visual_style.color_grade. Optional.
visual_anchor.prompt: <English prompt for SDXL Turbo — specific scene description with mood>

_doc: PER_EPISODE — actual story narration.
TARGET LENGTH: 1500–3000 Thai characters per block. Shorter = choppy; longer = audience drops off.
MOOD drives pacing (see tts.mood_pauses) AND music/ambience selection.
Allowed moods: cozy | funny | romantic | tense | melancholy | playful
duration_hint_sec is ADVISORY only — actual duration comes from real edge-tts output.
narration_blocks.narration: <Thai narration text — 1500–3000 chars. Describe atmosphere, emotions, small physical details. Use ๆ for repetition. Avoid English words.>

narration_blocks._doc: OPTIONAL second block in the same chapter. Lets you shift mood mid-chapter (e.g. melancholy → cozy) without changing the visual anchor.
narration_blocks.narration: <Thai narration text — continues the same chapter under a different mood.>

chapters._doc: Second chapter — pattern repeats. Reuse a library anchor when the scene returns to a known location.
chapters.title: <หัวข้อตอนที่สอง>

visual_anchor._doc: Example of REUSING a library anchor. Pretend ch_01 of episode 1 already promoted 'cafe_rainy_night_exterior'.

_doc: PER_EPISODE — credits and next-episode tease.
Plays for end_card.duration_sec after the last chapter. No narration (silent card).
end_card.next_episode_title: <ชื่อตอนถัดไป>
end_card.message: ขอบคุณที่ฟังจนจบ — ติดตามตอนต่อไปได้ในสัปดาห์หน้า
